## About
The Club Poker House is a poker room on Sunland Park Dr in El Paso. One reviewer described it as a place that feels more like a gathering of friends than a high-stakes pressure cooker, with clean tables, smooth lighting and dealers who keep the game fun and fair.
We hold a 5-star rating on Google from 32 reviews. A first-time visitor said the group made them feel at home right away, and another reviewer mentioned being greeted with a smile as soon as they came through the door.

## Services
- Poker: A clean, friendly room to play poker, with dealers who, as one reviewer put it, know how to keep the game fun and fair.
- Promotions: One reviewer said the promotions are great. Ask at the door about what is running.

## FAQ
Q: I have never played club poker. Is that okay?
A: Yes. One first-time visitor said the group made them feel at home right away and called the place hospitable, fun and friendly.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Saturday from 5:00 PM to 6:00 AM.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we are closed on Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are at 803 Sunland Park Dr Ste c, El Paso, TX 79912.
